description:
Industry clusters
Look up industry ids for the `industry_id` filter on `stories_organization_list` and `stories_industry_location_list`. Pass `search` with an industry in plain words (e.g. "biotech") to get the closest clusters, best match first, each with a `search_score` (lower is closer). Without `search` it pages through all ~6,000 clusters, so always search. Each result has `topic_id` (the value to pass as `industry_id`), `representative_doc` (example industry names), `representation` (key words) and links to broader (`parent_*`) and narrower (`child_*`) clusters. Usually you can pass the plain-words `industry` filter instead; use this to pin an exact cluster. 20 results per page (`page_size` up to 100). Free: no API key or payment needed.

page.description: A page number within the paginated result set.

page_size.description: Number of results to return per page.

search.description: Industry to search for, in plain words (e.g. "biotech", "ev charging"). Optional, but without it every cluster is listed.

name: industry_clusters_list
